title: Portfolio Update: Quality Equity Exposure
summary: A measured return to equity exposure.
coverage_note: All numbered text blocks and image labels read. Material theses, forecasts and explanations are included; routine holdings lists, incidental statistics, company descriptions and boilerplate are excluded. Chart pixels were not inspected.

claims.reason: Breakevens and equities recovered before the December package, so enacted stimulus was not required for improved markets. The author nevertheless added equity exposure, making the portfolio action less defensive than the headline regime label.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Business performance and shareholder return are distinct.

evidence.title: Ten-year inflation compensation sensitivity
evidence.finding: DGS 10 minus DFII 10: August 31, 2020 1.80%, September 14 1.65%, September 25 1.58%, December 23 1.97%. Breakeven includes inflation-risk and liquidity premia, not pure expected CPI.

evidence.title: Autumn 2020 correction
evidence.publisher: S&P Dow Jones Indices via FRED
evidence.finding: S&P 500 closes August 24 3431.28, September 2 3580.84, September 23 3236.92, December 24 3703.06. September peak-to-trough close decline approximately 9.60%, followed by new highs. Excludes dividends.

claims.reason: Subsequent inflation rose strongly, supporting that direction. The currency-devaluation measure and endpoint are unspecified, and later QT shows monetization was not a permanent necessary condition.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

evidence.title: June 2022 Consumer Price Index
evidence.finding: June 2022 headline CPI rose 9.1% over twelve months.

evidence.title: July 2023 FOMC statement
evidence.finding: Federal funds target increased to 5.25-5.50%; Treasury/MBS holdings continued to decline. This was tightening rather than a permanent low-rate cap.

claims.reason: Formal electoral-count objections establish a contested result. This does not quantify the predicted market-volatility impact, nor does it validate the objections' substance.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

evidence.title: Electoral-count objections
evidence.finding: The Congressional Record documents formal objections to 2020 electoral votes and separate chamber consideration. This establishes that the election result was contested, not that objections were valid.

claims.reason: The major deal came after the election and its COVID component was below the suggested 1.8-2 tn range. The author expressly allows talks to fail, so this is a failed near-term scenario rather than an unconditional promise.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

evidence.title: CARES and Consolidated Appropriations Acts
evidence.finding: The subsequent broad relief act passed Congress December 21 and was signed December 27, 2020, after the election rather than during summer.

claims.reason: The specifically disclosed RSP leg outperformed SHY at both three- and five-year checkpoints, supporting the risk-on direction. The full basket includes materially different outcomes and is not reconstructed, so no whole-portfolio win is asserted.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Business performance and shareholder return are distinct.

evidence.title: October 2020 equity/Treasury switch
evidence.finding: October 5, 2020-October 4, 2023: RSP adjusted-close+31.88%, SHY-2.92%; to October 3, 2025: RSP+87.22%, SHY+7.44%. USD, vendor distributions-adjusted proxies, no fees/taxes; not whole portfolio returns.

claims.reason: The statement lacks a covariance estimate, risk target and fixed holdings. Jurisdictional diversification may help, but common rates, global growth and regulatory shocks can affect different regions simultaneously.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

framework_lessons: Portfolio actions can differ from regime labels.
assessment: The timely increase in broad equity exposure worked over the stated 3-5 year window on the observable RSP leg, despite no immediate fiscal agreement. The contested-election and inflation directions were supported. Individual-stock substitutions and overall portfolio results need their own accounting.
verification_limitations: Retrieved 2026-11-07; publication-date wording is not authenticated.

Public market series are available, but not every investment claim has a defined horizon or reconciled corporate-action-adjusted return. Unverified outcomes remain unscored; macro data use latest available vintages.
